source: Wikimedia Commons, Category:Recitations of the Qur'an by Al Minshawi, files Sura_Minshawi_<surah>.ogg
licence: Public domain (PD-Egypt tag on Commons). Status outside Egypt not separately verified.
ayah_timing: https://mp3quran.net/api/v3/ayat_timing?surah=<n>&read=112 (used only to find the ayah windows)
fetch: Only a window around each ayah (ayah +-1 s, times from the ayat_timing API) was downloaded, not whole files: one HTTP range request for the Ogg headers (first 64 KB) and one for the window's bytes (+-40 s margin), decoded with ffmpeg -copyts. ~10.5 MB in all. Fragments cut by video/tools/cut_recitation.py; the cut points were checked phoneme by phoneme and are fixed in audio/recitation/cuts.json (manual).
listened: 2026-11-13: the teacher listened to all 10 fragments (audio/recitation/listen_all_10.wav) and approved them
